residual_risks: The gate authenticates local bytes and declared bindings but cannot itself establish the external semantic adequacy of every source.
claims.scope: The current package-local ntt_gate.py, its declared certificate and evidence schemas, and deterministic gate-contract fixtures evaluated against a caller-supplied local evidence root; semantic adequacy and execution provenance remain separate review obligations.
claims.text: The deterministic gate fails closed on relaxed thresholds, missing or aliased evidence, malformed or resource-exhausting JSON, invalid local paths, unsafe Markdown output destinations, unresolved contradictions, and automatic downstream closure. It requires substantive field-typed method M; binds canonical claim text, explicit scope, artifact or referent, importance, and method M in a versioned full claim contract carried by every strict evidence wrapper and observation record; and independently requires both reviewer-assigned semantic-equivalence classes and canonical structural fingerprints for nearby-world coverage. Its Markdown parent is acquired before evaluation and held through descriptor-relative installation. Ledger declarations are threshold-deduplication identities, not execution provenance. Under package-self, every modal declaration must match a complete immutable reviewed transition pin and the certificate-wide multiset must contain each of the 80 registered IDs exactly once; missing, extra, duplicate, or cross-claim/lane assignments fail.

method_m.producer: v1.0.3 package source and deterministic verification scripts

residual_risks: The dependency-free CI parser intentionally accepts only its documented restricted YAML subset.
Trusted PATH/Git binary selection and same-UID mutable Git metadata are environment assumptions; Git evidence is observational and additive only.
Linux subreaper cleanup assumes a single-purpose process with trustworthy /proc and no concurrent unrelated child ownership.
Private-mirror finalization does not bind non-root directory-mode drift; no authorization consumer depends on those directory modes.
claims.scope: The exact current physical package snapshot, stable-release inventory, declared workflow and release policy, self-certificate locator schema, and deterministic validator mutation fixtures. Standalone worktree validation does not prove HEAD/archive equivalence; the required unpacked git archive HEAD full self-test is the committed-archive behavior control. Future repository state, concurrent same-UID Git metadata coherence, and unavailable official validators are excluded.
claims.text: The closed-surface validator authorizes semantic reads, module execution, frontmatter parsing, and every package-derived fixture from one bounded immutable initial captured-byte and metadata snapshot. It rejects every physical cruft entry before activation in Git and Git-free packages, materializes fixtures only from captured bytes, applies independent path/metadata, file, aggregate, entry, depth, Git output, Git timeout, and Git index-entry ceilings, and independently revalidates the held source and private mirror at finalization. Bounded Git execution establishes Linux child-subreaper containment before spawn and kills and reaps original-group and adopted detached-session descendants on every exit, including ordinary success and post-Popen setup failure. Sanitized Git index/HEAD stage, mode, and cruft evidence is observational and additive rejection evidence only; absence never authorizes bytes or proves HEAD/archive equivalence, which is assessed only by the required unpacked git archive HEAD full self-test. The validator also enforces exact SHA-pinned CI action identities, release-command policy, canonical fixture identifiers, manifest and provenance integrity, executable-surface mutation rejection, descriptor-bound correction locators, and held no-follow output capabilities.

residual_risks: The 231-case suite uses synthetic stream-json and process fixtures; live Claude Code formal execution remains UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME.
Endpoint equality does not establish temporal immutability, so an otherwise PASS-TRACKED result remains capped at PASS-SCOPED.
The runtime identity binds the resolved entrypoint bytes, not the transitive interpreter, shared-library, kernel, or host dependency closure.
claims.scope: The current formal and live runner implementations and deterministic Linux contract fixtures under their declared JSON, process-containment, filesystem-capability, and resource limits; no live Claude Code run or temporal immutability is claimed.
claims.text: The formal and live runners authenticate a would-be PASS-TRACKED run only when the certificate gate passes and bounded complete runtime streams authenticate the exact native ntt-* call and result lanes with valid roles, unique matching IDs, and call-before-result ordering. Strict duplicate-key and finite-number JSON parsing, closed envelope validation, canonical and alias error-signal dominance, and authoritative-status conflict detection prevent contradictory live results from passing; formal result authentication rejects bare terminal-failure and unsupported scalar payloads while retaining contextual target-failure analysis. Untrusted captures, target copies, release trees, snapshots, and formal companions have explicit per-file, per-directory, entry, and aggregate resource caps. Execution requires supported Linux child-subreaper plus process-group containment before Popen and fails closed on unavailable containment or surviving descendants. Results bind endpoint-checked target and runtime identities plus the exact prompt, complete transcript, and gate and certificate companions; output checks are recomputed rather than self-attested. Output parents are acquired component-by-component without following links and held across evaluation, with canonical-result classification frozen before execution. These endpoint and capability observations are not temporal isolation, so results remain capped at PASS-SCOPED because temporal immutability is not mechanically enforced. Canonical SDK success requires api_error_status and deferred_tool_use to be null or absent, structured_output to be null or absent for this non-structured harness, terminal_reason to be null, absent, or completed, and stop_reason to be null, absent, or end_turn; live provenance and formal evidence_origin use schema 2.0.

consistency_sweep.activation_reason: The repeated PR #3 ultra-review corrected assurance-bound claim/world contracts, exact package transition inventory, official SDK result controls, provenance/origin promotion binding, immutable captured-byte package authorization, Git descendant containment and nonauthorization, physical-cruft policy, path privacy, and resource ceilings, so the mandatory whole-artifact stale-echo sweep was rerun against the final implementation.

corrected_claims.new_wording: Strict evidence requires string-typed SHA identities, closed type-checked evidence wrappers whose present optional identities are independently valid, substantive typed method fields, exact array-shaped claim reviews/modal collections, and an assurance-bound claim-contract 1.1 over the full claim; generic claim/modal IDs, targets, and evidence-reference lists have exact canonical shapes; world-contract 1.1 uses closed typed authorization fields, and package-self requires the complete immutable reviewed 80-transition multiset exactly once with pinned claim/kind and payload identities.
corrected_claims.old_wording: Method fields, claim identity, and nearby-world diversity could be weakened or relabeled without binding the complete reviewed contract.

corrected_claims.new_wording: Live configuration accepts only strict duplicate-free finite JSON and exact relative POSIX fixture paths; live and formal parsing accepts only canonical SDK ResultMessage success with explicit API/deferred/structured/terminal/stop controls; provenance/evidence-origin 2.0 is cross-bound into one exact promotion-method-m-v2 record, and formal output checks remain recomputed rather than self-attested.
corrected_claims.old_wording: Ambiguous live envelopes, incidental status text, scalar failure results, and caller-authored promotion method summaries could influence modeled pass decisions.

corrected_claims.new_wording: Package authorization consumes one bounded immutable initial captured-byte snapshot; semantic modules, frontmatter, and fixtures never reopen the mirror pathname. Physical cruft is rejected before activation, Git evidence is additive-only, bounded Git children are contained and reaped on every exit, and source plus private mirror are independently finalized. Exact current-root provenance is rejected before prose, path, and end delimiters without matching a hyphenated sibling. The certificate template records every correction locator with a one-to-one excerpt binding and accurately scaffolds the closed wrapper fields, modal binding alternatives, typed eight-field method manifests, and critical evidence/world minima enforced by the gate.
corrected_claims.old_wording: Consistency corrections could use unresolvable descriptive paths, and package snapshots or mode identities could diverge from bounded Git semantics.

corrected_claims.new_wording: Remote escalation records use exact base fields and resolution-conditional fetched evidence with claim-status consistency.
corrected_claims.old_wording: Remote escalation resolution could be asserted without complete fetched and re-adjudicated evidence.

corrected_claims.new_wording: UNKNOWN is the claim-level vocabulary; UNVERIFIED is reserved for whole-artifact gate status.
corrected_claims.old_wording: Some active material used UNVERIFIED as a claim status.
